title: Build a PNR
description: Use PRINT: Itinerary, Name, Phone/contact, Ticketing, Received From.
workflow: AN → SS → NM → AP/APE → TKOK/TKTL → RF; then end as required.

title: Price a booked itinerary
description: Customer keeps the selected flights but wants the lowest fare available for those flights.
workflow: Use FXR to check and FXB to save the lowest fare; FX/FXP are the booked-class family in the supplied Session 5 transcript.

title: Find market alternatives
description: Customer is flexible about airline and wants route-wide options.
workflow: Use FXD; Session 26 distinguishes FXD from FXB because FXD displays alternatives for the route.

title: Surface gap
description: Passenger arrives in Mumbai and later departs Delhi.
workflow: Use SIARNK so the itinerary records the surface gap.

title: Split passengers
description: One passenger in a shared PNR needs a different itinerary.
workflow: Use SP with the passenger selection, RF/EF to finalize as taught, retrieve the resulting PNR, then modify it.

title: Void
description: A ticket must be voided within the applicable market window.
workflow: Check ticket image with TWD, then use TRDC L[line] or TRDC/TK[ticket number] according to the supplied Session 27 workflow.

title: Involuntary exchange
description: Airline changed a flight and supplied a waiver.
workflow: The supplied Session 28 workflow uses ERK for TK→HK, FXI, endorsement/waiver handling, OS, TQT, TTPE and TWD verification.

title: Name correction
workflow: The transcript emphasizes airline authorization/rules before name modification. Use HE NM for name-element help and follow the authorized airline-specific procedure.

title: Manual exchange
description: ATC cannot handle a case and a penalty is collected separately.
workflow: The manual-exchange sessions require checking fare rules, original ticket data and calculating the exchange manually; use the exact source workflow rather than inventing a production format.

title: Queue
description: Agent wants to ignore the current queue item but leave it in the queue.
workflow: Use QI. QD is the delay-and-retrieve-next workflow.

title: Ticket issue
description: PNR is priced and ticketing elements are present.
workflow: Review fare/TST elements as required, ensure FP/FE/FM/FV requirements are satisfied, then use TTP in the supplied Session 6 workflow.

title: Support
description: Agent does not know the command for a task.
workflow: Use HE/ for help on the last transaction or targeted help such as HE NM / HE STEPS.
